title: drimia altissima
intro: Drimia altissima, commonly known as Devil's Claw or Harpagophytum altissimum, is a plant species native to southern Africa. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and pain, as well as alleviating symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The therapeutic actions of Drimia altissima include its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and spasmolytic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, specifically harpagoside, which is responsible for its medicinal properties.
